title: Chapter 184: Gripped by Passion
html:
Chen Ge still had countless questions, but the boy gave him no chance to ask them before beginning the countdown. The child was clearly struggling as well. He had not fully recovered, and the blood-red color of his clothes was fading. “Stop wasting time. Go!”

As Chen Ge approached, he noticed countless fine cracks in the door. Blood vessels wove through them, slowly repairing the damage. He recalled the explosive crash that heralded Zhang Ya’s return. “After the old man forced her out, Zhang Ya broke through again. So the door can be damaged, but it repairs itself.”

He pushed it open and stepped into a world no longer drenched in red. For once, the dark corridor felt comforting.

“Meow?” The white cat crouched beside the doorway and regarded him with bright, mismatched eyes. Chen Ge turned to thank the boy, only to have the door slammed in his face.

The boy is hiding something—but what? Is he afraid of Zhang Ya?The image of a red school uniform fluttering in an unseen wind crossed Chen Ge’s mind, and he shuddered. The three-star Trial Mission had transformed his understanding of Zhang Ya. As a Red Specter, she was the complete opposite of the girl she had been in life: cruel, merciless, capable of shattering the door and destroying anyone who stood in her way.

Zhang Ya came through with me, didn’t she?Chen Ge turned. She stood barely a foot away, the red of her uniform brighter than ever.

His fingers twitched uncontrollably. Concealing his panic with an awkward laugh, he said, “It’s almost funny. I went through the door because I was worried about you, but you ended up saving me.”

Zhang Ya said nothing, merely studying his face. Chen Ge froze beneath her scrutiny. As he searched for a way to lighten the mood, he realized that in more than twenty years of life, he had accumulated precisely no experience talking to girls.

What have I been doing for the past twenty years?At last, he managed, “Everything here is settled. Let’s go home.”

Zhang Ya did not answer. She stepped forward until her face nearly touched his, then abruptly accelerated, passing through his body and vanishing into his shadow.

The black phone vibrated in his pocket. Chen Ge leaned against the wall and slid to the floor, his forehead slick with cold sweat. The pressure Zhang Ya exerted was overwhelming.

“Is that an alert that the mission has been completed?” After taking a deep breath, Chen Ge took out the phone and opened the alert.

“Zhang Ya’s affection level increased slightly! Soon, it will break through to the next level—Gripped by Passion!”

The alert made Chen Ge draw a sharp breath. Gripped by Passion? Why does that sound so dangerous? Will Zhang Ya accidentally tear me apart in the heat of the moment?

He clutched his head and groaned in terror. The white cat leaped onto his backpack and sprawled there lazily, apparently accustomed to its owner’s strange behavior.

There’s no point worrying about that yet.Chen Ge stood and checked his phone. All signal had vanished after he entered the door. Then he remembered the livestream. On opening the platform, he discovered that his broadcast had been suspended, though his account remained active and he could still post comments.

What’s going on?

He checked the figures. A single broadcast had driven his follower count to 150,000. Every major livestream seemed to be discussing him and Qin Guang. After collecting himself, Chen Ge searched for Qin Guang’s channel and found that it too had been suspended.

What happened?Chen Ge called Liu Dao. Someone answered after seven rings. “Liu Dao? Why were Qin Guang’s stream and mine both shut down? Was the screen black for too long?”

After a few seconds, an unknown male voice replied, “This is the city’s investigation team. Give me your location immediately. Stay where you are, and don’t move around.”

The police? When did they arrive, and how did they know I was at the Third Sick Hall?The time was already 3:50 a.m. He had spent only a short while behind the door, yet hours had passed in reality. When his broadcast cut out, Liu Dao’s team had probably contacted the police. Unlike the online audience, they understood the danger and knew Chen Ge’s exact location.

“I’m on the first floor of the hospital’s third building. Two victims were trapped in the second building’s laundry room, and I’ve collected evidence identifying the suspects.”

“The two victims have been rescued. Don’t ruin the crime scene. We’ll be there in a minute; keep the line open.”

“My battery is almost dead, so the call won’t last much longer.” Chen Ge hung up and immediately concealed the hammer and cleaver.

I have to take the thing inside the director’s dresser too.

He raced to the second-floor office. While retrieving the letters from the cabinet, he accidentally discovered its secret: the rear panel opened onto a hidden passage ending at a steel door.

The key in Chen Ge’s possession fit the lock. When he opened the door, he was astonished to find himself back in Room 3.

This must be the secret passage Wang Haiming mentioned in Room 3. It connects directly to the director’s office, so the old man unquestionably knew about it.

The patient’s bed faced the hidden entrance. Remembering that Men Nan’s mother had stayed in this room, Chen Ge began to understand why the boy had tormented the former director.

Wang Haiming once lived in Room 3. He and the mirror ghost probably stole this key from the director.

With the police due any moment, Chen Ge pocketed the key, restored everything to its original position, and sat quietly in the room to wait.

At 4:00 a.m., the police forced open the Third Sick Hall. Chen Ge hurried to meet them with his backpack, a dead rooster in one hand, and the white cat asleep on his shoulder.

Before Chen Ge got near, the police surrounded him. Chen Ge had not seen any of these faces before.

“I’m a friend! I’ve found these things left behind by the suspects.”

After a brief interrogation, Chen Ge explained why he had entered the Third Sick Hall. Omitting every supernatural detail, he said the twisted-faced man had chased him and that the escaped patients had locked him inside.

“The suspects left fingerprints on the fourth-floor steel door. There are three of them, and all were once patients in the Third Sick Hall.”

He fought to remain awake until dawn. Once the black phone confirmed the mission’s completion, Chen Ge left the hospital with the police.
